                     Cancel Itinerary Confirmation
                     Hi Jane,

                     You’ve successfully canceled your trip. While we're sorry to see you go,
                     we want to ensure you have all the information you need regarding
                     your cancellation.

                     Please keep the ticket/document number(s) below as they have
                     become an eCredit and the remaining value can be used to book a
                     flight before the standard expiration date listed on your eCredit.

                     A few things to keep in mind:

                         • To view the details of your eCredit, please visit My Wallet on the
                           Fly Delta App or go to delta.com/redeem.

                         • If your purchase included Trip Insurance, your insurance premium
                           must be canceled separately through Allianz Global Assistance
                           and will be refunded if you cancel the policy within 10 days of
                           purchase. Please cancel your policy online or by contacting
                           Allianz Global Assistance at 1-800-284-8300. A policy number is
                           required to process the cancellation. Please refer to a separate
                           email sent by Allianz which includes the policy details.

                     When you're ready to travel again, we're ready for you. You can go to
                     delta.com/redeem where you'll be able to apply this eCredit at the time
                     of purchase.

                     We are very grateful for your business and hope you'll continue to
                     choose Delta, our Delta Connection carriers and our SkyTeam partners
                     for your future travel needs.


                           Passenger Name              Ticket/Document Number


                           JANE TRAVELER                 0060000000001

                                                                     Privacy Policy




                        Terms & Conditions

                        Tickets are non-refundable unless the original ticket was issued at a fully refundable fare. Some fares
                        may not allow changes. If allowed, any change to your itinerary may require payment of a change fee
                        and increased fare. Failure to appear for any flight without notice to Delta will result in cancellation of
                        your remaining reservation.

                        If you purchased a Delta Main Basic (Basic Economy) fare, a cancellation charge may apply - if the
                        cancellation charge exceeds the ticket price, an eCredit will not be issued.



                        Note: When using certain vouchers to purchase tickets, remaining credits may not be refunded.
                        Additional charges and/or credits may apply.

                        Conditions of Carriage

                        Air transportation on Delta and the Delta Connection® carriers is subject to Delta's conditions of
                        carriage.

                        Privacy Policy

                        Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy.
